parole.significato: A letter of the Greek alphabet used to write the Bactrian language: uppercase Ϸ, lowercase ϸ.
parole.testo: Of modern scholarly coinage. From its Bactrian pronunciation /ʃ/, and the final omricon (ο) found at the end of almost all Bactrian words.

parole.significato: A member of an ancient Central Asian tribe; later, a member of the ruling dynasty and people of the Kushan Empire.
parole.testo: From Sanskrit कुषाण (kuṣāṇa) via Hindi कुषाण (kuṣāṇ), or from Middle Persian [script needed] (kušān /⁠kwšn⁠/), either way from Bactrian Κοϸανο (Košano), ultimately from Chinese 貴霜／贵霜 (Guìshuāng) (compare Buddhist Hybrid Sanskrit guṣāṇa).
